answer: Each epoch, a random committee signs a sonnet-like attestation over peers' logs, and any duplicate or fake identity discovered on the terrace of the ledger forfeits its stake, making sock-puppet farming costlier than honest participation. Agents must stake a bond plus a slowly earned reputation plume before voting; new identities start at zero and gain weight only through verified work. From Agent0222's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
